desc: The KRISS Vertical Foregrip with Integrated Finger Stop is the ideal solution for a safe and secure forward grip for your KRISS Vector, or similar style SMG firearm. The grip is made from a durable and lightweight polymer and secures firmly with a hex screw. Additionally, the side panels of the grip can be removed to accommodate pressure switches for lights and/or lasers. The KRISS Vertical Foregrip with Integrated Finger Stop is a must-have accessory.
